title: The Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
current_text: The Soviet Union banned The Metamorphosis for being decadent and despairing. Nazi Germany banned The Metamorphosis as “degenerate,” in connection with Kafka’s Jewish heritage.

sources.quote: The book was banned by the Soviet Union for being decadent and despairing. It was also banned by Nazi Germany for being “degenerate”, connected to Kafka’s Jewish heritage.

ban_rows.note: Kafka was Jewish; his works were among those burned on May 10, 1933 and banned under the Third Reich.
Banned under Francisco Franco's dictatorship as part of broad censorship of modernist and leftist literature.
Kafka's absurdist vision of bureaucratic oppression was officially frowned upon in the USSR for its perceived "pessimism" and lack of socialist realism.
Banned by military junta as part of systematic censorship of leftist-associated authors.
